profile.name: AngularJS Essentials
profile.bio: A curated reference exploring AngularJS core building blocks: two-way data binding, dependency injection, directives, services, and asynchronous data fetching with $http.

items.title: Two-Way Data Binding & Scope
items.description: AngularJS automatically synchronizes data between the Model ($scope) and the View (DOM). When the model changes, the view updates, and when the user changes the view (e.g. input), the model updates instantly.

items.title: Controllers & $scope Lifecycle
items.description: Controllers are constructor functions that decorate an AngularJS Scope. They contain business logic and expose data/functions that the template can bind to.

items.title: Data Fetching with $http
items.description: The $http service is a core AngularJS service for communicating with remote HTTP servers via XMLHttpRequest or JSONP. It returns promises for clean asynchronous flow.

items.title: Directives (ng-repeat, ng-if, ng-show)
items.description: Directives are markers on DOM elements that tell AngularJS to attach a specified behavior or transform the DOM element and its children.

items.title: Services vs Factories vs Providers
items.description: All three create singletons for sharing state and logic across controllers. Factories return an object, services are instantiated with 'new', and providers allow module configuration before bootstrap.

items.title: Custom Filters & Transformations
items.description: Filters format the value of an expression for display to the user. They can be used in view templates, controllers, or services.
